items.title: 75234_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: that's when Charles damn near went haywire, because she couldn't figure out how she could go off and leave him, as tight as he had been with him.

ctx.x: Anyway, so I joined the band, and we went up to Cheyenne, we had a bus wreck up in Montana. Basically that group I was with in Albuquerque had also joined the band with me when I joined Harriet's band. So we went up to Winnipeg and down to Grand Rapids, Michigan. And when we got to Grand Rapids, Michigan, Harriet cut out and left the band stranded, you know, without paying the band. Of course, I think that they thought they were slick.
Well, anyway, that's when Charles damn near went haywire, because she couldn't figure out how she could go off and leave him, as tight as he had been with him.
